title: Integrated operations
intro: Review, track and decide in one place.
localNotice: Local preparation: records and confirmations here are drafts. Real operations remain in connected screens.
empty: No connected data in this area
emptyHelp: Explore the examples or prepare a draft.
forbidden: This area is unavailable for your access.
aboutText: The interface prepares workflows. Real confirmations require server-side permissions, audit, persistence and reconciliation. Examples are not official records.
saveError: Could not save. Keep this page open and try again.
invalid: Check the values and required fields.
confirmText: This action records a simulation in this draft only. Continue?
permission: Approval requires an authorized manager or owner role.
name: Product or reference
closingHelp: Totals come from shift sales and movements. Each payment portion is reconciled separately.
receiptHelp: Enter reference, method and amount. A receipt alone does not confirm settlement. Camera reading awaits integration; this page stores no images.
bagHelp: Unique code per closing, custodian and count. Handover and second count are separate steps.
journalHelp: Sales, payment portions and movements have separate entries. Corrections reference the original and preserve history.
returnHelp: Record the issue and applicable policy. An authorized manager reviews without overriding consumer rights. The original sale is preserved.
fiscalHelp: Return, payment and tax document statuses are independent. Tax handling depends on the transaction and jurisdiction.
inventoryHelp: The company decides when to count. Staff count; an authorized manager approves. Sales during counting are included.
reservedHelp: Units reserved for offline devices are not released by counting, expiry or a screen adjustment.
auditHelp: Authorized auditors review counts, reasons and approvals. Granting and revoking access requires the server.
qualityHelp: Raw material → approved formula → production → finished batch → customer. The formula version used is preserved.
safetyHelp: Safety sheets, reports, hazards, storage and technical ownership follow each product and activity. This page does not approve formulas or replace reports.
quarantineHelp: Under review: this batch cannot be offered as available for sale.
supplyHelp: The system suggests replenishment. The buyer accepts or rejects; the supplier confirms terms and delivery.
visit: Suggest seller contact after three rejections
driverHelp: The driver checks at dispatch and delivery; the recipient records receipt. Times are agreed considering manual route stops too.
collectionHelp: Request before delivery. The supplier defines acceptance, product credit or cash and timing. Collection can accompany a new delivery; after ending the relationship, use a nearby route or agreed deadline. Return arrival is confirmed.
opportunityHelp: Compare similar size, activity, region and period using authorized aggregates. Offers and trials need both companies to accept.
consent: Aggregate sharing authorized by the companies
performanceHelp: Low sales do not imply a loss. Consider margin, tied-up capital, waste, seasonality and production time and labor.
discountHelp: Discount suggestions respect cost and defined limits. Selling at a loss requires an explicit decision; prices are not reduced automatically.
devicesHelp: Each device sells only its exclusive allocation. Local, server and cloud communication share this rule.
offlineRules: Expiry does not release stock. Retries do not duplicate sales. Old backups require revalidation. Revoked devices retain pending records for review.
networkHelp: Without a communication path there is no shared confirmation. This demonstration performs no real transfers.
reviewNeeded: Translation requires native-speaker review before production.
newCaseHelp: Start a new draft in this area? Simulation history is preserved.
exampleHelp: Replace this area’s fields with an example?
termsHelp: The system records the agreement. Delivery discrepancies open a review; it does not alter payment slips, charge Pix or promise refunds without agreement and integration.
trialHelp: Trials are optional for both companies. Space and charts support decisions; no order is placed automatically.
backupHelp: Restoration must be tested. Old data does not automatically reactivate permissions or stock allocations.
unitHelp: Quantities accept up to three decimals in the same unit. Mass and volume are not converted without approved parameters.
notMatched: The data does not match the selected payment portion
realCash: Connected cash register: current opening and closing
replaceDemo: Replace this draft with examples? Previous activity is preserved.
emptyWorkspace: No connected records. Load the demonstration or prepare a procedure.
unbalanced: Payment portions do not add up to the sale.
cameraHelp: Live view, no photo saved. Enter receipt details; automatic text reading is not connected yet.
cameraError: Could not open camera. Check and enter the details manually.
approveDifference: A difference requires a reason and authorized approval.
refund_unbalanced: Allocate the full refund across payment portions.
importHelp: CSV: sku;unit;location;recorded;counted;movements. Quantities up to three decimals.
readOnlyHelp: Read-only view of this page; it grants no external access or permissions.
negative_stock: The adjustment would leave negative stock; review movements.
qualityBlocked: Complete and review tests before releasing the batch.
documentHelp: The file is available in this session. Only name and type enter the draft; upload to the authorized repository requires integration.
checklistRequired: Check all items and enter the driver.
collectionPolicy: In an active relationship, combine collection with delivery. After termination, agree a nearby route or supplier deadline.
noComparable: No offer matches the authorized cohort.
trialOff: Supplier offers no trial; a purchase can still be considered.
trialAccepted: Both companies agree to consider a trial
seasonComparison: Compare with same period last year
belowCost: Price below cost: explicit decision and reason required.
stockIsNotLoss: Low volume and idle stock need analysis; neither alone means a loss.
idempotent: Operation already recorded; no allocation duplicated.
origin_unavailable: The source must participate and confirm the lock; no credit was granted.
noPermission: Your role cannot approve this action.
demoAction: Confirm this draft action? Commercial records are unchanged.
tooLarge: File or draft exceeds the allowed limit.
saveFailed: Could not save; keep the page open and retry.
declaredEvidence: Declared record; this form does not restore a backup.
reissueHelp: Old rights remain suspended. A new quota consumes the available central balance.
trialBuyer: Buyer agrees to consider a trial
_translationReview: Revisão por falante nativo pendente antes da produção.
correctReceipt: Correct this receipt metadata? The previous record will be preserved.
fleetIntro: Organize vehicles, expenses, trips and delivery checks.
foodIntro: Menu products and service; you choose the sectors.
documentsIntro: Find documents, track versions and organize reviews.
purchasingIntro: Compare quotations and prepare approved purchases and receiving.
commercialIntro: Manage customers, opportunities, quotations and orders.
businessLocal: Local workspace. These actions prepare drafts and do not change commercial operations.
businessAbout: Examples appear only after confirmation. Partner messaging, payments, fiscal services and live location require integration. Documents stay on this computer.
fleetHelp: The manager controls availability. A vehicle on a trip cannot enter maintenance.
trackingUnavailable: Live location is not connected. Times and proofs on this screen are entered in the draft.
vehicleBusy: This vehicle is already on an active trip.
odometerRegression: Odometer cannot be lower than its last value.
duplicatePlate: Check the plate: seven characters, no duplicates.
dispatchBlocked: Check available vehicle, driver, load and addresses before departure.
pendingStops: Check all deliveries or record exceptions before finishing.
foodIntegration: iFood, printer and payments await connection. This is a local workspace.
noPaymentCapture: Amounts are declared for checking; this screen does not charge or confirm bank payments.
tableBusy: Enter a free table. This table already has an active ticket.
paymentMismatch: Declared payments must add up to the total.
deliveryBlocked: Enter customer, address and courier; linking a trip requires an available vehicle.
documentsHelp: Organize by folder, relation and expiry. Each upload creates a preserved version.
documentPrivacy: Files stay on this computer in this context. They are not digital signatures or an official server archive.
documentLimits: PDF, PNG, JPEG or TXT; up to 2 MB per file and 16 MB per workspace.
documentLimit: Unsupported format or storage limit exceeded.
documentStored: File and version stored on this computer.
signaturePending: Electronic signature and external sharing are not connected.
fileUnavailable: File unavailable on this computer. Attach a version before approval.
purchaseHelp: Orders require human approval. Preparing dispatch does not confirm supplier acceptance.
compareQuoteHelp: Compare the same SKU, unit and quantity. Include freight and lead time; no automatic selection.
purchaseNoSend: Approval and receiving stay in the local workspace. No order was sent, stock changed or charge created.
xmlHelp: Read NF-e XML to review items and prepare intake. It does not import tax rules or validate signatures.
xmlNoFiscal: Up to 1 MB and 200 lines. Accepts un/kg/g/L, quantities up to 3 decimals and prices up to 2 nonzero decimals. Other precision requires manual review.
confirmSupplierXML: Review and select the registered supplier; XML does not link it automatically.
xmlInvalid: Invalid XML, oversized file or unsupported precision. Check file and values.
xmlUnits: Unit unsupported in this preview. Convert and review manually.
xmlDuplicate: This XML key is already in the workspace.
commercialHelp: Customers and proposals in one workspace, with history and follow-up.
commercialNoSend: This order is a local draft. It does not message, invoice, charge, pay commissions or reserve stock.
goalsHelp: Tracks only accepted orders in this workspace by creation date. This is not received revenue.
customerDuplicate: This tax identifier is already in the workspace.
quoteExpired: Proposal expired. Prepare a new proposal before converting.
emptyItems: Add at least one valid item.
transition: State changed. Check the current step before continuing.
deliveryIntro: Picking, dispatch and delivery for any business.
recipesIntro: Save a recipe, enter ingredients and see production capacity.
sectorsIntro: Choose activity and enable only the features your business uses.
planningNotice: Workspace saved on this computer. Stock and confirmations belong to local planning.
sectorsAbout: Does not change official stock, payments or invoices. Backend must still connect sectors, POS and devices. Previous records are preserved.
setupHelp: Define activity, departments and features here for all work areas.
yourSectors: Which sectors exist in your business?
deliveryForAll: Delivery serves shops, pharmacies, food service, industry or other businesses. No kitchen or tables required.
featuresRespectPlan: Enabling features does not subscribe modules or grant permissions. Availability depends on plan and role.
askManagerSetup: Ask the manager to configure this installation’s sectors.
profileLocal: Configuration stays in this context’s local workspace; it is not yet shared with other devices.
genericDeliveryHelp: A delivery has an origin, recipient, contents and courier. Preparation belongs to its responsible sector, not this screen.
startDeliveryHelp: Enter the order, recipient and picking sector.
deliveryLocal: States and times are declared on this computer. Live location, remote confirmation and commercial posting are not connected.
firstRecipeHelp: Enter available ingredients and save your first recipe. Capacity appears on its card without loading samples.
recipePlanningHelp: Enter planning balances or bring previous records. This screen does not move official stock or POS data.
stockPlanningOnly: This balance is declared for recipe planning. It is not live store inventory.
canProduceUpTo: Available ingredients can produce up to
alternativesNotSum: Capacities are alternatives: recipes may share ingredients. Reserving one reduces availability for others.
reserveHelp: Reservation is local and prevents double-use only in this workspace. It does not reserve other devices’ stock.
productionFlowHelp: Reserve → start → check actual consumption and yield → complete planning.
finishedGoodsPending: Finished goods appear in this plan. Official stock receipt and checkout communication require backend integration.
addIngredientsFirst: First add ingredients in “Ingredients and planning balance”. Closing preserves your fields.
firstMenuHelp: Add name, category, description, price and extras. Then open an order to test choices.
optionsHelp: Create groups such as size or extras, with minimum/maximum selections and prices.
foodLocal86: Local preparation workspace. No payment capture, invoices or iFood/printer dispatch.
unitMismatch: Incompatible units: check weight, volume or units.
insufficientPlanning: Planning balance is insufficient or reserved by another production.
courierRequired: Choose an active courier before dispatch.
courierBusy: Courier has an active delivery; finish before deactivating.
demoSteps: Mix, prepare and check yield. Fictional example.
noPrevious: No previous records found in this context.
profileHelp87: Define activity, departments and features here for all work areas.
profileLocal87: Profile saved for this company and store on this computer. Other devices require server synchronization.
profileSaved87: Profile updated. Work areas now use this configuration.
profileConflict87: Another window changed the profile. Reopen this page before saving.
featureOffHelp87: Enable this feature in Settings, subject to your plan and permissions.
foodNeedsProfile87: Configure food services in Settings to use menus, preparation or tables. Deliveries work separately.
proposalHelp87: This profile accompanies the proposal. After signing in to the correct company, review it in Settings before applying.
